## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?  
CAUTION. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive. Tech weakness vs broad sector gains creates mixed signals (Technology -4.86% 1W while Consumer Staples, Energy and Healthcare lead); Leadership: Broad (5 sectors in Top 5); Style: mixed / no clear leadership.

2. Which sectors are leading?  
Consumer Staples lead: WMT (1W: +6.70% | 1M: +11.26%) ABOVE TREND, HD (1W: +6.50% | 1M: +2.35%) ABOVE TREND. Energy strong: XOM (1W: +5.94% | 1M: +9.62%) ABOVE TREND, COP (1W: +9.25% | 1M: +10.00%) ABOVE TREND. Healthcare strong: LLY (1W: +6.59% | 1M: +9.08%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +5.83% | 1M: +6.99%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?  
Technology lagging: NVDA (1W: -6.61% | 1M: -2.38%) BELOW TREND, AVGO (1W: -9.07% | 1M: -5.17%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -9.31% | 1M: -14.53%) BELOW TREND. Industrials mixed with headline weakness: CAT (1W: -8.71% | 1M: -8.49%) BELOW TREND, BA (1W: -0.08% | 1M: -3.45%) BELOW TREND. Financials uneven: JPM (1W: +2.02% | 1M: -2.26%) RECOVERY, V (1W: +4.45% | 1M: +8.83%) ABOVE TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?  
Top 5: ACN (1W: +10.74% | 1M: +21.67%) ABOVE TREND, COP (1W: +9.25% | 1M: +10.00%) ABOVE TREND, LMT (1W: +8.34% | 1M: +2.60%) ABOVE TREND, VZ (1W: +7.54% | 1M: -5.89%) RECOVERY, SBUX (1W: +7.46% | 1M: +0.88%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Broad (5 sectors in Top 5).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?  
Bottom 5: AMAT (1W: -19.28% | 1M: -1.94%) BELOW TREND, PANW (1W: -18.33% | 1M: -8.81%) BELOW TREND, LRCX (1W: -17.22% | 1M: -1.89%) BELOW TREND, INTC (1W: -14.18% | 1M: -17.42%) BELOW TREND, AMD (1W: -13.05% | 1M: -3.00%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in Technology.

6. Momentum Stocks?  
Strongest 1W movers: ACN (1W: +10.74% | 1M: +21.67%) ABOVE TREND, COP (1W: +9.25% | 1M: +10.00%) ABOVE TREND, LMT (1W: +8.34% | 1M: +2.60%) ABOVE TREND, VZ (1W: +7.54% | 1M: -5.89%) RECOVERY, TMUS (1W: +7.08% | 1M: -4.42%) RECOVERY — note a MAJOR DIVERGENCE across large caps (multiple 1W vs 1M mismatches), so treat moves as tactical opportunities, not broad confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?  
Technology shows material short-term selling: AAPL (1W: +2.03% | 1M: +1.92%) ABOVE TREND is an outlier while NVDA (1W: -6.61% | 1M: -2.38%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -1.13% | 1M: +6.29%) CORRECTION and GOOGL (1W: -3.15% | 1M: -1.94%) BELOW TREND highlight rotation away from several mega-caps; watch for follow-through.

8. Financials Outlook?  
Financials mixed but showing pockets of strength: V (1W: +4.45% | 1M: +8.83%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +4.80% | 1M: +9.30%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +2.02% | 1M: -2.26%) RECOVERY — breadth inside Financials is uneven, supporting the broader CAUTION verdict.

9. Healthcare Outlook?  
Healthcare is constructive: LLY (1W: +6.59% | 1M: +9.08%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +5.83% | 1M: +6.99%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: +4.60% | 1M: +7.02%) ABOVE TREND — sector leadership helping offset Tech weakness.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?  
Favor exposure to sectors showing confirmed ABOVE TREND leadership (Energy XOM (1W: +5.94% | 1M: +9.62%) ABOVE TREND, Healthcare LLY (1W: +6.59% | 1M: +9.08%) ABOVE TREND, Consumer Staples WMT (1W: +6.70% | 1M: +11.26%) ABOVE TREND) and reduce exposure to large-cap Tech names with BELOW TREND labels; style: mixed / no clear leadership, prioritize selectivity amid divergence.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: ACN (1W: +10.74% | 1M: +21.67%) ABOVE TREND, COP (1W: +9.25% | 1M: +10.00%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +6.59% | 1M: +9.08%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: INTC (1W: -14.18% | 1M: -17.42%) BELOW TREND, AMAT (1W: -19.28% | 1M: -1.94%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: Energy (XOM (1W: +5.94% | 1M: +9.62%) ABOVE TREND, COP (1W: +9.25% | 1M: +10.00%) ABOVE TREND) and Healthcare (LLY ABOVE TREND).  
BEARISH: Technology (NVDA (1W: -6.61% | 1M: -2.38%) BELOW TREND, AVGO (1W: -9.07% | 1M: -5.17%) BELOW TREND).

13. Key Levels & Triggers?  
NVDA 1W weakness; watch short-term support near recent monthly lows (NVDA (1W: -6.61% | 1M: -2.38%) BELOW TREND). AAPL support zone around recent consolidation (AAPL (1W: +2.03% | 1M: +1.92%) ABOVE TREND). XOM breakout confirmation above recent highs to extend ABOVE TREND move (XOM (1W: +5.94% | 1M: +9.62%) ABOVE TREND).

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?  
LLY (+80): LLY (1W: +6.59% | 1M: +9.08%) ABOVE TREND — EU regulator backing confirms price strength.  
META (+50): META (1W: -1.30% | 1M: +4.04%) CORRECTION — analyst upgrades vs small 1W pullback = bullish sentiment but short-term distribution risk.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?  
INTC (-50): INTC (1W: -14.18% | 1M: -17.42%) BELOW TREND — negative headlines confirm heavy selling.  
PLTR (-45): PLTR (1W: -11.01% | 1M: +5.55%) RECOVERY — bearish commentary while 1M strength signals mixed setup, monitor closely.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION; Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive; Leadership: Broad (5 sectors in Top 5); Style: mixed / no clear leadership.  
LLY (1W: +6.59% | 1M: +9.08%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +5.94% | 1M: +9.62%) ABOVE TREND and ACN (1W: +10.74% | 1M: +21.67%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength.  
Key risk: Tech divergence is material (NVDA, INTC, AVGO BELOW TREND and multiple mega-caps in CORRECTION), and bearish news on INTC is confirming price action — watch for trend confirmation before adding to core exposure.
